scope: Original M1 complete physical quality audit for same fixed cached generic RPN/ROI -> existing class-agnostic ByteTrack; not training, semantic M9, feature cache or automatic primary qualification
selection: Entire unchanged source video/image metadata universe in ascending video ID and strict chronological annotated frame order; no GT category/track sampling, target enrichment, omission or replacement
model_view: Sequential current anonymous boxes/foreground probabilities only; no native IDs/track boxes, embeddings, category/prototype/GT/future/text input
quality_contract: Unchanged raw RPN/ROI one-class foreground probability det_score in [0,1]; no sigmoid/clamp/normalization/calibration/NMS/cap added by wrapper. Existing ByteTrack built-in fixed gates/minarea and Kalman boxes preserved.

provenance.reported_training: Main models: SA-1B-500K, frozen official SAM foundation; SAM track-head-only final6-epoch phase disclosed in J.2; other BDD/COCO and TETer domain-adaptation experiments are separate, not automatically release lineage
provenance.runtime: One-class native RPN/ROI, no Detic, vocabulary, semantic checkpoint metadata fallback, text, GT, public detections or offline filtering

cadence_boundary: ByteTrack resets at entire-video first registered frame, ordinal annotated-only cadence,30 annotated-step lost horizon with frozen frame_rate30/buffer30; native MASA memo10 differs. PANDAS retains dense-frame history/different detector. Complete route comparison, not isolated threshold/memory/architecture causation.
causality_probe: First4 full-source frames of first ascending video, two fresh tracker resets; fixed1000px future2 box shift, scores unchanged, exact nonempty first2 prefix outputs. Probe never scored, production source unmodified.

evaluation.canonical: Pinned TAO_OW/SUBSET=all/MAX_DETECTIONS=300 and HOTA unchanged; one-video owned disposable scratch, count-weighted combine, no duplicated whole-Val GT/pred JSON
evaluation.coverage: Geometric tIoU>=0.5 Hungarian on entire full-Val Known/Novel GT target universe; same denominator for all routes
evaluation.purity: Class-free per-frame geometric matching first; only posthoc category/individual mixing aggregate, unmatched rows unknown and retained
evaluation.lengths: Full-Val annotated-cadence/projection lengths, not dense-frame lifetime
evaluation.old_baselines: Reproduce all native/PANDAS four metrics at full and per-video levels; coverage/purity/lengths/counts/source hashes exactly, otherwise INCOMPARABLE
evaluation.scratch: Only a newly created per-video temporary directory under this owned run may be removed after scoring; retain prediction shards, supervisor logs, aggregate/per-video evidence and failed attempt marker

stop_rules: Exact remote preregistration/source identities/resource headroom before replay; no automatic overwrite or retry of completed/partial attempt
All988video seals/36375 production+8probe calls/worker exit0 before independent GT/role access
Do not tune from tinyNovel1/2 or fullVal outcomes; no threshold/buffer/score/NMS/cap/crop or learned-weight changes
Do not infer primary PASS from longer tracks, matched-only purity, interface tests or candidate name; explicit full quality/provenance/common-input judgment remains required
No R2, GT-policy expansion, semantic M11, formal feature cache, Test, foreign process intervention or main training
publish: Aggregate and per-video metrics/coverage/pollution/lengths/hashes/resources only; no raw targets/GT joins/semantic names, predictions/weights/GT payloads remain private
